children: Madhur Gupta moves to RPSG’s media business after finance leadership roles across publishing, manufacturing and consumer facing businesses

RP Sanjiv Goenka Group has appointed Madhur Gupta as Chief Financial Officer for its media business, marking his move into a senior finance leadership role within the group’s media and entertainment portfolio.

Gupta joins RPSG from HarperCollins Publishers India, where he served as Chief Financial Officer. His career spans finance and business leadership across publishing and other industries, with experience in financial management, profitability improvement, business transformation and operational strategy.
He has also held leadership roles at Hero Steels and previously served as CEO of Hero Realty, where he was responsible for driving business growth and operational performance.

In his new role at RPSG, Gupta will work with the media leadership team on financial strategy, sustainable growth and value creation as the group continues to expand its media and entertainment businesses.

Gupta said the opportunity to join RPSG’s media business brings together the group’s strong legacy with its forward looking approach to media and entertainment, adding that he looks forward to helping shape its next phase of growth.
